properties.notes: Site comprising a redundant tennis court and other vacant land. Permission in place for construction of 15 residential dwellings and associated landscaping and infrastructure (A/2010/0450). This has been implemented by the construction of an access road but the residential aspect of development is yet to commence. Scheme forecast to be delivered within next 5 years. The brownfield element (0.32ha) represents around two-thirds of site - a yield of around 5 dwellings can be calculated based on methodological approach. For indicative purposes in the BF Register, the original SHLAA site (ref 0280) is split to reflect brownfield and greenfield elements - total area of 0.96ha. No progress made to date on the residential development and the site will remain on the BF Register.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
